anime.b: The most perfect, cozy, and beautiful story I've ever read or watched. Luffy is one of the best MCs of all time — the story building, world building, character depth and lore is out of this world. Oda feels like he isn't human with the way he connects every single detail across 1000+ episodes. Even arcs without the main cast are entertaining, which no other anime or TV series has ever pulled off at this scale. Pacing is the only real issue — easily fixed by skipping filler.
One of the greatest stories ever written. The 1997 anime did it justice but everything after that has been a disaster visually. Waiting on a proper full adaptation.
extra: 🎬 Note: Needs a proper full adaptation

anime.tagline: Eyes say yes, brain says meh.
anime.b: Story is bland and straightforward, but the animation is absolutely stunning — some of the best in anime history. It's the kind of show where you watch it for the visuals, not the plot.
Crazy animation but the story is honestly overrated — no real emotional depth. That said, Gojo is one of the most iconic characters in modern anime. Looking forward to the Gojo vs Sukuna arc.

Well-balanced anime with incredible story building — but all that setup led to a dumb, immature ending. Eren had zero meaningful character growth beyond hatred and mass murder, which wasn't satisfying at all as a conclusion.
Wholesome and fun. A bit slow-paced but perfect for light viewing. Anya is iconic.

anime.tagline: Does exactly what it needs to.
anime.b: Very simple story with a power-fantasy MC — nothing groundbreaking but it's satisfying and entertaining. Knows what it is and delivers on it.
Unique MC premise that sets it apart, but the story hasn't gone deep enough yet. Potential is there.

anime.tagline: Solid — just hope it doesn't get dragged.
anime.b: Currently good and entertaining. The manga arcs ahead could get dragged in the anime format though, which is a concern. Enjoying it for now.
extra: 👀 Watching how future arcs are handled

anime.tagline: Not for everyone, but genuinely refreshing.
anime.b: Not my usual cup of tea but it offers something different — slow, reflective, and emotionally quiet. Respectable anime, just not a personal favourite.
Solid anime overall — definitely borrows from others (Naruto vibes especially) but builds its own identity well. Asta's grind is genuinely motivating.
Very well-balanced with a great concept, solid pacing, and some of the best animation in its season. Deserves more attention than it gets.

anime.tagline: Peak until L's death. Then it falls apart.
anime.b: One of the greatest psychological thrillers ever made — until L dies. The second half becomes a completely different, inferior show. Yagami's ending was a massive letdown. Classic but flawed.
Solid anime with a cool concept. Not much more to say yet — enjoying it.

anime.tagline: Fine but needs to pick up.
anime.b: Alright so far but the story is moving too slow. Needs to find its direction and commit.
Good anime from start to finish. The ending wraps things up in an okay way — not spectacular, but fitting. One of the better "power isn't everything" stories out there.

anime.tagline: Interesting concept — keeping an eye on it.
anime.b: The core concept is genuinely interesting. Waiting to see how the story develops, especially with the Goddess storyline.
Alright watch. Short enough that pacing isn't an issue. Sad ending but it fits the world.
Dark and unusual premise. Not something I'd recommend widely but it's unique for what it is.

Complex storytelling and themes that don't always blend smoothly — the world-building feels inconsistent at times. But the core concept and story are genuinely interesting. Worth watching for what it tries to do.

anime.tagline: Unique and interesting story with devils.
anime.b: The story is genuinely good and animation also superb. The MC is a pervert but he's been portrayed as a modern day teen who falls for any girls who charm him. But we all know how boring and dumb the story is ending. This is an anime and manga I genuinely enjoyed but the ending disappointed me so much. Since the anime hasn't caught up with the manga, the rating is higher only for the anime because it's just finished the Reze arc.

Genuinely loved this one. What stands out is how mature and sincere it feels — it's not leaning on the usual rom-com tropes or fanservice, it actually builds a real, slow-burn emotional connection between two people. Felt like real people falling for each other instead of an "anime-ified" version of romance. Currently reading further into the manga to keep going past where the anime left off.

anime.t: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
anime.b: One of the best stories I've recently watched and it felt like a fresh breath of air. This completely changed
anime.noteTitle: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

anime.tagline: Starts charming. Then everything gets fucked.
anime.b: Boring start but became super interesting and dark around episode 6 — from there it was superb nonstop. One moment it's cool and charming, next moment everything falls apart. Love this story. Subaru is a dumbass but his selflessness and the unspeakable torment he goes through makes him one of the most compelling MCs I've watched. The "Return by Death" mechanic isn't a cheat power — it's a curse that breaks him over and over and you feel every single loop. One of the best isekai anime I've ever watched and also can confidently say that this one of the best anime's I've ever watched. One episode packs so much trauma, details, pain man i love this show.
anime.noteTitle: Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World

anime.b: Start is genuinely weird and uncomfortable but fades by episode 5 and the real story kicks in. Worldbuilding is very solid for an isekai — not One Piece level but impressive. Characters are well thought out and genuinely likable. The relationships hit hard especially when everyone reunites. Rudeus earned his respect — he owned his mistakes and actually made up for them in his new life. Caught up to S3 Episode 4.

Never thought I'd watch a school anime but this is peak. Looks boring from the outside but every episode is tense and interesting. Ayanokoji is goated — selfish but the way he uses everything at his disposal to achieve his goal is something to learn from. Not saying everything about him is perfect but the way he operates is fascinating.
Still finding it slow at the start but committed to pushing through. Planning to get to the Soul Society arc before making a proper judgment.
Visually it's superb and also have a engaging superb story can't wait for the other episodes
It's okay so far. Not blown away yet but I've heard the Chimera Ant arc changes everything — holding out for that.
Was on pause before but picked it back up and it's peak now. Watching it together with nangi which makes it even better. Previous doubts about momentum gone — fully committed now.
Brand new anime, only 4 episodes out so far. Still too early to feel anything strong about it. Will update once more episodes drop.
Highly recommended, mature story similar to Berserk vibes
Classic. Considered one of the best ever made
Heard ending was crazy
